matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the exact Rodrigues-formula coefficient in Eq. (3), namely the erroneous use of (1 + cosθ) instead of (1 - cosθ), and demonstrates its invalid rotation consequence.

Finding 2 explicitly flags the undefined and unconstrained β_t in the same diffusion equation z_t = α_t z_0 + β_t δ_t ε. Its additional timestep-range criticism does not prevent it from detecting the β notation defect.

No finding identifies the altered z_motion channel dimension k×5×h×w or its inconsistency with the other latent-channel shapes. Finding 3 concerns a separate temporal-dimension issue involving k = K/4 and K = 49.

It detects the undefined β_t introduced in the stated diffusion-noising equation.
It raises a distinct, concrete tensor temporal-dimension inconsistency not represented in the ground truth.
